entities.name: Höllentalbahn (Black Forest)
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Höllentalbahn is a railway line that partially runs through the Höllental valley in the Black Forest of Germany. The line connects Freiburg im Breisgau with Donaueschingen, a distance of 74.7 km (46.4 mi).
